name: Tetso Shopping Worlds
description: The Tetso Shopping Worlds were a group of planets located within the Tetso system, in the Slice portion of the Core Worlds that was known as the Arrowhead. In 2 ABY, Princess Mi expressed interest in visiting the Tetso Shopping Worlds.
